name: companion
description: Hypotrail Bank Marketing workshop in a webview: apply a choice and receive an explanation in the panel through the VS Code language model API (GitHub Copilot).

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The local Python engine requires a trusted workspace.

languageModelTools.name: hypotrail_tutorial_status
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read shared Bank Marketing tutorial state: recorded choice, applied choice, and existing result. Does not modify the project or train a model.

languageModelTools.name: hypotrail_tutorial_apply
languageModelTools.displayName: Apply a choice in the exercise
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Explicitly apply a recorded tutorial choice after reading its status. Confirms no project decision and starts no training. Rejects stale context.

languageModelTools.name: hypotrail_tutorial_explain
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Publish a pilot explanation in the Bank Marketing tutorial webview. To attach it to an applied choice, provide applicationEventId (application.event_id) and contextHash from hypotrailTutorialStatus; otherwise it appears as an unattached message. Does not interrupt an ongoing panel response or change any project decision.
